profile_text.body:
Salesforce, founded in 1999 and headquartered in San Francisco, California, is a public company that reported revenue of $41.525 billion as of January 31, 2026. The company describes its AI offerings as helping teams work more productively within their existing workflows. Slack AI, embedded in Salesforce's messaging platform, can summarize channels and threads, search files, take meeting notes, translate conversations, and automate workflows. Slackbot functions as a personal AI agent that understands users and their workspace, helping prepare for meetings, analyze reports, and create project briefs. According to the company's site, customer data is not used to train large language models, and LLM providers do not have access to customer data, with LLMs hosted directly within Slack's AWS virtual private cloud.

Salesforce also offers Tableau AI (Einstein) for business intelligence with natural language queries and CRM data integration, and Salesforce Einstein/Agentforce, which provides CRM-embedded AI and agents. The company states that Slack serves as the conversational interface for Agentforce, allowing agents to run directly in Slack channels, threads, and direct messages. AI features are available across all paid Slack plans.

According to theworldofai.org's registry, Salesforce has significant legal exposure with 220 cases tracked in California. The company has six Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers registered, including ai.cirra/salesforce-mcp for Salesforce administration, multiple Kodey AI Salesforce MCPs for running SOQL queries, and cloud.serpent/salesforce-devops for planning Salesforce deployments and triggering pipelines.
